description: Merge a GitLab merge request immediately or enable auto-merge when checks pass. A successful merge is irreversible, and should_remove_source_branch can also delete the source branch.

auto_merge.description: If true, merge automatically when all required checks pass.
auto_merge.title: Auto Merge

merge_commit_message.description: Custom message for the merge commit.
merge_commit_message.title: Merge Commit Message

merge_request_iid.description: The internal ID of the merge request to merge.
merge_request_iid.title: Merge Request Iid

project_id.description: The numeric ID or namespace path of the project.
project_id.title: Project Id

sha.description: Expected HEAD SHA of the source branch. The merge fails if the current HEAD differs.
sha.title: Sha

should_remove_source_branch.description: If true, remove the source branch after the merge.
should_remove_source_branch.title: Should Remove Source Branch

squash.description: If true, squash all commits into one commit when merging.
squash.title: Squash

squash_commit_message.description: Custom message for the squash commit.
squash_commit_message.title: Squash Commit Message

name: merge_merge_request

merge_request.description: The merged merge request or its updated auto-merge state.
merge_request.title: Merge Request

detailed_merge_status.description: Detailed mergeability status reported by GitLab.
detailed_merge_status.title: Detailed Merge Status

id.description: Global ID of the merge request.
id.title: Id

iid.description: Project-scoped internal ID of the merge request.
iid.title: Iid

merge_commit_sha.description: SHA of the resulting merge commit, when available.
merge_commit_sha.title: Merge Commit Sha

merge_user.description: User who merged or configured auto-merge for the request.
merge_user.title: Merge User

merged_at.description: Timestamp when the merge request was merged.
merged_at.title: Merged At

sha.description: HEAD SHA of the merge request source branch.
sha.title: Sha

should_remove_source_branch.description: Whether the source branch is configured for removal.
should_remove_source_branch.title: Should Remove Source Branch

squash.description: Whether commits are configured to be squashed.
squash.title: Squash

squash_commit_sha.description: SHA of the resulting squash commit, when available.
squash_commit_sha.title: Squash Commit Sha

web_url.description: Web URL of the merge request.
web_url.title: Web Url
